title: Oven Braised Mediterranean Tripe Tagine
description: A rich and savory lacto-vegetarian dish featuring tripe, cooked in a tagine style with Mediterranean spices and ingredients, perfect for a lazy Sunday

ingredients.name: tripe
ingredients.notes: honeycomb or smooth, cleaned and cut into bite sized pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the tripe and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the canned tomatoes, vegetable broth, feta cheese, dried oregano, paprika, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the tripe for 2 1/2 hours, or until it is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the tripe hot, garnished with fresh parsley or oregano if desired.
